title: Times table
prompt: Return the times table for n as an array of ten numbers: n times 1 up to n times 10.

docs.name: for item in list:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines once per item, with item holding each value in turn.

docs.name: range(a, b)
docs.what: The whole numbers from a up to but not including b. range(n) starts at 0.

docs.name: list.append(value)
docs.what: Adds value to the end of the array. Returns nothing.
